summary: Lithium Argentina AG filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026, along with related management discussion and analysis and certifications. The report shows net income of $7.5M (basic EPS $0.05) vs a net loss of $7.2M in 2025, with assets of $1.16B and equity of $833M. This is a routine periodic financial filing by a foreign private issuer reporting quarterly results. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is mentioned. The filing is ordinary course and does not trigger a special-situations classification.
